dialogues.speaker: "Thelxie" Development Log (II)
dialogues.text: ...I've hit a snag. I had planned to apply for a transcription module to use for Thelxie, and it would have been the same one as the one used in the diving helmet, but the warehouse is out of stock...

dialogues.speaker: "Thelxie" Development Log (II)
dialogues.text: ...Seems like I'll have to make one from scratch using the one I have as a reference. I'll start looking into it, but it's unclear if I'll have enough time...
